{
  "need": "Status",
  "secondary": { "name": "Belonging" },
  "read": "This player is broadcasting their value to everyone watching — teammates, opponents, coaches, maybe family in the stands. The showboating is a loud answer to a quiet fear: do I matter here? The secondary belonging risk is real too, because the very move meant to earn respect is costing them the room.",
  "pull": { "collapse": "Enforcer", "instinct": "Call them out in front of the group or bench them to make a point — but that publicly strips their status and proves to them the team is not a safe place to matter, which deepens the hunger driving the behavior." },
  "mentorMove": "Acknowledge their competence privately and directly so they do not have to perform for it, then connect team celebration to a higher standard they will actually want to live up to.",
  "holdFirm": ["Every good play gets celebrated — that standard stays", "How we celebrate reflects on the whole team, every time"],
  "stayFlexible": ["Let them lead the team in designing what big-play celebration looks like", "Find a visible role that gives them status through contribution, not solo spotlight"],
  "forceLevel": { "level": 2, "label": "Questions" },
  "script": [
    { "phase": "Connection", "words": "Hey, pull up for a second. You been making some real plays out there — I want to talk to you for a minute, not because you're in trouble." },
    { "phase": "Curiosity", "words": "When you light it up like that, what are you going for after? Like what's the feeling you want in that moment?" },
    { "phase": "Collaboration", "words": "Here is what I am seeing from the sideline — your teammates go a little flat right after those moments, and I do not think that is what you want. You want them fired up with you, right? So help me figure out what that looks like, because you are the one who can actually set the tone on this team." },
    { "phase": "Commitment", "words": "I am holding you to this because my standard for you is higher than a highlight — I think you can be the guy who makes everyone around you better, and I genuinely believe you can do it. That is a harder thing to pull off than any single play, and it is worth more." }
  ],
  "longGame": "Give this player a real leadership role that channels the need to be seen — captain of warmups, calling out teammates for good effort publicly — so status comes through elevating others, not over them."
}
situation: A player showboats after good plays and it is rubbing teammates the wrong way.
